provenance.dataset_content_hash: not computed; immutable source/split manifest must be supplied separately

contract.checks: touched rows and selected induced adjacency, not a full-graph scan
contract.target_removal: both src->dst and dst->src, in directed and undirected modes
contract.drnl: endpoint-deleted shortest paths on undirected view
contract.scope: frozen S -> induced CSR; sampling/setup/oracle/validation excluded
contract.stock: selected-row gather + SciPy column fancy indexing; full-graph SciPy construction excluded
contract.padding: virtual isolated vertices; S, original arrays and local structure fixed
contract.uncertainty: timing quantiles, not confidence intervals; repeated samples share graph/cache
